data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** 52cd3ad71beeb9b9a40f02b6d0b07d67226d31d9
* **files:** plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/per-worktree-review-commit.md (Step 3.5); plugins/dso/scripts/check-session-merge-only.sh; plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh
* **mode:** dso.workflow=ci-pr, .sprint-active present (sprint waxen-sigma)

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Workflow gate mutual-incompatibility

#### Expected Behavior
Per-worktree Step 3.5 copies .sprint-active into the agent worktree so check-sprint-trailer.sh enforces the DSO-Story trailer (bug e081-63c0). Step 4 then commits the agent's staged changes in the worktree branch successfully.

#### Actual Behavior
check-session-merge-only.sh exits 1 for ANY non-merge commit in a linked worktree whose REPO_ROOT contains .sprint-active. Because Step 3.5 just placed .sprint-active there, the Step 4 per-task commit is rejected:
  "ERROR: Direct commit to session worktree rejected (sprint-active mode)."
Observed verbatim during sprint waxen-sigma Layer-0 harvest of task 5e96. Removing the copied .sprint-active from the agent worktree let the identical commit succeed (Session Worktree Merge-Only Check: Passed).

The two hooks both key on .sprint-active presence and are mutually exclusive on an agent worktree: copying it satisfies check-sprint-trailer but trips check-session-merge-only; not copying it satisfies merge-only but skips trailer enforcement.

#### Suggested direction (not prescriptive)
check-session-merge-only.sh should exempt agent worktrees (path contains /.claude/worktrees/agent-) since those are the harvest source, not the session worktree; OR Step 3.5 should not propagate .sprint-active.

### 5. Skills and Workflows
* Workaround used in this session: skip Step 3.5 (do not propagate .sprint-active); commit succeeds; DSO-Story trailer included manually in the commit message.
data.title: [per-worktree-review-commit]: Step 3.5 .sprint-active copy makes check-session-merge-only reject the per-task commit
